Confidential

“A celebratory weekend in Venice for Cressida’s birthday, featuring spectacular celebrations and precision logistics, experiences and revelry” with music and entertainment to match the style, setting and seamless delivery. Initial ideas below, ready to develop and refine.

  • Format: Various formats available depending on the artist and desired feel.
  • Repertoire: Artists have extensive, adaptable repertoires, with additional tracks available on request, subject to suitability, fee and preparation time. DJs are comfortable working with clients and briefs.
  • Styling: Artists can be styled to complement the event aesthetic and dress code.
  • Roaming: Where appropriate, artists can perform roaming, moving naturally through the space rather than from a fixed position.

Artist fees are in range categories at this stage, and exclude VAT, travel, accommodation and hospitality expenses.

Welcome Evening & Lunches

Various options could slot into any one of these three moments, depending on the location and vibe. Friday sets the tone while remaining in the background, Saturday lunch has an opportunity to soothe any hangovers before ramping up a little 'main day' energy, while Sunday could be a special performance that gets a bit more attention.

Next Steps

  • Ready to book: If you'd like to go ahead with any of the artists, let us know and we can get the booking process underway. A 50% deposit is required to secure the selected artist and date.
  • Refining the selection: If you'd like to consider alternative options or refine the direction, just let us know. We're also happy to discuss any other music moments across the event.
  • Artists presented as On Hold: Availability is based on artists' calendars at the time of this proposal and is subject to change and reconfirmation.

Proposal Terms

  • This proposal and recommendations are provided solely for evaluating entertainment options for this event and may be shared internally for planning purposes but should not be shared externally with artists, agencies or unrelated third parties.
  • Artists and suppliers introduced or recommended by Miro Sounds must be booked through Miro Sounds unless otherwise agreed in writing.
  • If an introduced artist or supplier is subsequently approached or booked directly, Miro Sounds reserves the right to charge an appropriate fee.

About Us

We curate exceptional music for unforgettable events. From the familiar to the fresh, the refined to the raw, we're here to help you find the perfect pairing of sound & setting for every moment.

Bringing 15 years of expertise across music, events and sound curation, we source from a trusted global network of phenomenal musicians, handpicking talent tailored for each event, without the restrictions of a fixed roster, ensuring every experience feels truly personal.

Tell us the vision and we'll take it from there, fine-tuning every element to make sure it all flows seamlessly - initial consultation, genre & artist curation, booking & logistics, onsite management.

Rory MacInnes - Founder
